authored.observedEffect: A direct pinned compiler/assembler probe of build/sol-five-family/shop-splitter-integrated-state0-state8.c emits 4580 bytes/1145 instructions, frame 112, and all sixteen retail switch destinations. Object disassembly shows the state-0 base/cursor copies at function offsets 0xA4 and 0xA8, and the no-argument call at 0x1A4 with the zero store in its delay slot, as in retail. A direct opcode-only census over existing retail and scratch object words counted four state-0 opcode differences versus 105 in 5C21, and 55 full-owner differences versus 156 in 5C21. These are scratch diagnostics, not linked-byte acceptance. An authenticated workbench watch of this integrated source was interrupted before a result was delivered; no authenticated score is claimed.
